offers.name: Pacing Analysis

Stateless: nothing submitted or computed is stored.

thresholdEstimate.evidenceStatus: Workwell Foundation clinical rule of thumb; no validating primary study found (targeted PubMed search, 2026-09-01). Present as an informal heuristic, never as a validated instrument.

flags.message: Today's HRV (RMSSD) deviates notably below this person's own rolling baseline.

offers.name: Orphan-Patch Score

offers.name: Base Address Balance
offers.description: Native ETH balance for one Base network address, read live from a public Base RPC node (eth_getBalance) and returned with the snapshot block it was read at.

offers.name: Base Gas Oracle
offers.description: Current Base network gas price, read live from a public Base RPC node (eth_gasPrice) and returned in both wei and gwei with the snapshot block it was read at.

offers.name: Base Transaction Check
offers.description: Look up one Base network transaction by its hash, read live from a public Base RPC node (eth_getTransactionByHash). Returns found:false (billably) for a hash the node does not know.

offers.name: Trashpanda Base Pre-Sign Policy Conformance
offers.description: Deterministically evaluates one unsigned Base transaction against the buyer's exact policy and immutable block anchor before signing, returning a replayable clause-by-clause PASS, FAIL, or ESCALATE receipt. No keys, signatures, custody, signing, or broadcast authority are accepted.

offers.name: Trashpanda Market Action Admission
offers.description: Deterministically evaluates one proposed market action against the buyer's exact policy, immutable snapshot, fees, risk limits, and customer-declared public evidence, returning a replayable ADMIT, REFUSE, or ESCALATE receipt. It does not predict markets, handle keys, hold custody, sign, place orders, or execute trades.

claims.statement: Public example claim for API discovery only.

offers.description: Mandate-bound paper portfolio and typed order intent, for paper (non-live) venue accounts. No live venue effect.

offers.description: Normalize and reconcile a customer-supplied pair of Alpaca account snapshots (expected vs. observed), reporting every field mismatch beyond tolerance.

offers.name: Brokerage Report Graphic Render

record.body: Malignant catatonia is a severe variant of the catatonic syndrome marked by hyperthermia, autonomic instability, and severe rigidity, historically described in the world literature as "lethal catatonia" because of its substantial risk of death if untreated.
